en: The image shows a sepia-toned historical street scene viewed through a large stone archway with a decorative crest above it. People in early 20th-century attire are seen walking and standing along the cobblestone street. The architecture is distinctly Northern European, with gabled rooftops and stone facades. The text 'REVAL. GROSSE STRANDPFORTE.' is printed on the lower part of the image, and there is also vertical text on the right-hand side.
